name: limadata-mcp
description: Enrich people and companies, prospect leads, monitor Professional Network changes, and search with the Limadata API.
long_description: Exposes 27 Limadata tools to Claude: enrich, search, prospect, watch/monitor, find emails/phones/profiles, company lookup, database search (BETA), and credits balance. Get an API key at https://app.limadata.com/settings/apikeys.

tools.name: enrich_person
tools.description: Enrich a professional profile by email, Professional Network URL, or name+company.

tools.name: enrich_company
tools.description: Enrich a company profile by domain or Professional Network URL.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search for people with keyword filters.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search for companies with filters.

tools.name: get_company_insights
tools.description: Get company insights from Business Intelligence by identifier or domain.

tools.name: get_profnet_posts
tools.description: Fetch Professional Network posts for a profile URL.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search Professional Network posts by keywords.

tools.name: get_credits_balance
tools.description: Check remaining credits on the Limadata account.

tools.name: find_work_email
tools.description: Find a person's work email by full name and company domain.

tools.name: find_phone_number
tools.description: Find phone numbers for a person by Professional Network URL or name+company.

tools.name: resolve_identity
tools.description: Find social profile URLs (Professional Network, GitHub, X, Facebook) from name+company.

tools.name: find_company_profnet
tools.description: Find a company's Professional Network URL from its domain.

tools.name: reverse_email_lookup
tools.description: Find social profiles from a person's email address.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get company data from a Professional Network company URL.

tools.name: get_company_jobs
tools.description: Get job listings for a Professional Network company page.

tools.name: prospect_companies_filter
tools.description: Advanced company prospecting with granular filters (25 credits).

tools.name: prospect_companies_by_url
tools.description: Prospect companies using a Sales Navigator search URL (25 credits).

tools.name: prospect_people_filter
tools.description: Advanced people prospecting with granular filters (25 credits).

tools.name: prospect_people_by_url
tools.description: Prospect people using a Sales Navigator search URL (25 credits).

tools.name: prospect_employees
tools.description: Get current employees of a company for prospecting (25 credits).

tools.name: create_watch
tools.description: Create a persistent Professional Network monitoring watch subscription.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List all watch subscriptions for the account.

tools.name: get_watch
tools.description: Get a watch subscription by ID.

tools.name: update_watch
tools.description: Update or pause/resume a watch subscription.

tools.name: get_watch_mock_payload
tools.description: Get a sample webhook payload for a watch type.

tools.name: database_search_company
tools.description: Search company database via AI prompt, filters, or expression (BETA).

tools.name: database_search_people
tools.description: Search people database via AI prompt, filters, or expression (BETA).
